agent_explanation: At step 12 body 0 is 0.014 outside wall 0 moving at ~58 m/s (vx 28.1, vy -50.8). Even with 9 substeps the discrete collision/positional-correction cannot resolve the fast approach and inter-body momentum exchange before penetration. At step 13 distance_to_surface becomes -0.1526 (overlap 0.1526 > 0.15 limit), violating no_wall_penetration. Reducing dt (finer integration) removes the tunneling while keeping all else identical.
